title: Laguna Beach Retreat
meta_description: Welcome to Laguna Beach Retreat! Modern 5BR coastal retreat with heated private pool - steps to the beach, minutes to Pier Park \& 30A!
description_expanded:
Welcome to Laguna Beach Retreat, a sun-soaked escape where contemporary comfort meets one of Panama City Beach's most beloved coastal neighborhoods. Just steps from beach access at the end of the street, you can be on the soft sands and emerald waters of Laguna Beach in minutes---or hop on the golf cart (available to rent), for an easy, breezy ride to the shore.

Designed with a clean, crisp aesthetic, this stunning five-bedroom, 4.5-bath home offers plenty of space for groups to spread out and settle in. The living room invites relaxed evenings with plush seating and a TV, while the open layout flows seamlessly into a sleek, fully equipped kitchen---perfect for prepping beach-day snacks or gathering for casual meals. A spacious dining table seats six, complemented by additional barstool seating at the island for easy, social dining.

Step outside to your private backyard oasis, where vacation mode truly kicks in. Lounge poolside under the Florida sun, cool off with a refreshing dip in the heated pool, or fire up the BBQ for laid-back afternoons that turn into warm, breezy nights. With ample patio space and sun loungers, this is your own personal retreat---no crowds required.

Each of the five beautifully appointed bedrooms features a king bed, offering hotel-worthy comfort and privacy for every guest. Bonus bunk nooks add extra flexibility for kids or groups of friends, making this home ideal for multi-generational stays or getaways with friends. In-home laundry and convenient parking keep everything effortless throughout your stay.

Located on the quieter west end of Panama City Beach, Laguna Beach Retreat puts you close to it all while maintaining a relaxed, residential feel. Pier Park is just minutes away for shopping, dining, and entertainment, and the scenic beaches and coastal towns of 30A are also only a short drive from the home. After a day of exploring, return to your private retreat where poolside evenings and coastal calm await.

Whether you're here for beach days, golf-cart cruises, or unhurried time by the pool, Laguna Beach Retreat offers the perfect blend of location, comfort, and coastal ease.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips.

Local Attractions: St. Andrews State Park, Camp Helen State Park, Ms. Newby's and Runaway Island (karaoke), Jimmy Buffett's Margaritaville, Pier Park, Gulf World Marine Park, Water Planet, Little Village Waterfront Shopping Market, SkyWheel, Shipwreck Island Waterpark.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure views, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Home Truths:
- Please note our occupancy includes an additional two beyond bed count. Trifold floor mattresses and additional linens can be provided upon request.
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Pool heat is available for an additional fee and must be requested 24-48 hours before your stay.

Parking Details:
- Parking is available for four vehicles.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
